note: The icons on the VR Portal home screen. Each entry: name, icon (an emoji or one or two letters), kind ("page" opens a web page, "window" opens a window the home page provides, named by app), url or app, an optional color (#rrggbb), and "about": a short line shown on its card (about 60 letters at most, to stay readable in the viewer). An entry that is not right is left out with a warning; the rest still load.

apps.about: Cut flying fruit with your finger or your gaze.
